post.summary: Evaluate a typed cap scenario in caller order

200.description: Successful response. Payroll, roster, cap-hold, team-salary, and cap-room state are caller-order scenario state; moves that are syntactically valid but illegal or unresolved can be included and are disclosed by the contamination flags.

includes_illegal_moves.description: Whether final scenario state includes a move validation rejected as illegal or a prohibited trade.

includes_unvalidated_moves.description: Whether final scenario state includes an applied signing whose legality could not be established.

422.description: Invalid scenario request or domain error

get.summary: Read a team's cap sheet with labeled payroll components

200.description: Cap sheet rows. Dead-money rows are labeled payroll components rather than roster players. Committed salary is roster payroll plus dead money; payroll adds cap holds and incomplete-roster charges. component_availability distinguishes an unavailable component from a true zero.

committed.description: Roster payroll plus dead money in US dollars.

roster_payroll.description: Roster-player salary in US dollars. Check component_availability.roster_payroll before treating it as a declared decomposition.

payroll.description: Committed salary plus declared cap holds and incomplete-roster charges in US dollars.

422.description: Missing team, unavailable salary data, or domain error
